1: // Meteor Dodge game with enhanced graphics
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
4: canvas.width = 400;
5: canvas.height = 600;
6: 
7: // Load simple sound effects (replace URLs with your own files if desired)
8: const sfx = {
9:   // short ping for each avoided meteor
10:   point: new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/hchiam/awesome-audio/ping.mp3'),
11:   // crash sound for collision
12:   crash: new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/hchiam/awesome-audio/crash.mp3'),
13: };
14: // Ensure sounds are allowed to play (may require user interaction first)
15: Object.values(sfx).forEach(a => a.load());
16: 
17: // Background stars for a space feel
18: const stars = Array.from({ length: 100 }, () => ({
19:   x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
20:   y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
21:   radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
22: }));
23: 
24: function drawBackground() {
25:   // space black
26:   ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
27:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
28:   // tiny stars
29:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
30:   stars.forEach(s => {
31:     ctx.beginPath();
32:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
33:     ctx.fill();
34:   });
35: }
36: 
37: // Ship – rendered as a sleek triangle
38: const ship = {
39:   width: 40,
40:   height: 20,
41:   x: canvas.width / 2 - 20,
42:   y: canvas.height - 30,
43:   speed: 5,
44:   color: '#00ffff', // cyan
45: };
46: 
47: function drawShip() {
48:   ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
49:   ctx.beginPath();
50:   ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.height);
51:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.width / 2, ship.y);
52:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.width, ship.y + ship.height);
53:   ctx.closePath();
54:   ctx.fill();
55: }
56: 
57: let leftPressed = false;
58: let rightPressed = false;
59: let meteors = [];
60: let score = 0;
61: let gameOver = false;
62: let frameCount = 0;
63: 
64: function spawnMeteor() {
65:   const size = 20 + Math.random() * 20;
66:   meteors.push({
67:     x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size),
68:     y: -size,
69:     size,
70:     speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2 + frameCount * 0.001,
71:     // create radial gradient for a glowing effect
72:     gradient: null,
73:   });
74: }
75: 
76: function drawMeteors() {
77:   meteors.forEach(m => {
78:     // create gradient once per meteor
79:     if (!m.gradient) {
80:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
81:         m.x + m.size / 2,
82:         m.y + m.size / 2,
83:         0,
84:         m.x + m.size / 2,
85:         m.y + m.size / 2,
86:         m.size / 2
87:       );
88:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff8800');
89:       grad.addColorStop(0.7, '#ff4400');
90:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#aa0000');
91:       m.gradient = grad;
92:     }
93:     ctx.fillStyle = m.gradient;
94:     ctx.beginPath();
95:     ctx.arc(m.x + m.size / 2, m.y + m.size / 2, m.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
96:     ctx.fill();
97:   });
98: }
99: 
100: function updateMeteors() {
101:   meteors.forEach((m, i) => {
102:     m.y += m.speed;
103:     // remove off‑screen meteors and increase score
104:     if (m.y - m.size > canvas.height) {
105:       meteors.splice(i, 1);
106:       score++;
107:       // play point sound on successful dodge
108:       sfx.point.currentTime = 0;
109:       sfx.point.play();
110:     }
111:     // ship‑meteor collision
112:     if (
113:       m.x < ship.x + ship.width &&
114:       m.x + m.size > ship.x &&
115:       m.y < ship.y + ship.height &&
116:       m.y + m.size > ship.y
117:     ) {
118:       gameOver = true;
119:       // play crash sound
120:       sfx.crash.currentTime = 0;
121:       sfx.crash.play();
122:     }
123:   });
124: }
125: 
126: function drawScore() {
127:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
128:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
129:   ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
130: }
131: 
132: function gameLoop() {
133:   if (gameOver) {
134:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
135:     ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
136:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 80, canvas.height / 2);
137:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, canvas.width / 2 - 60, canvas.height / 2 + 40);
138:     return;
139:   }
140:   drawBackground();
141:   // handle input
142:   if (leftPressed && ship.x > 0) ship.x -= ship.speed;
143:   if (rightPressed && ship.x + ship.width < canvas.width) ship.x += ship.speed;
144: 
145:   if (frameCount % 60 === 0) spawnMeteor();
146: 
147:   updateMeteors();
148:   drawMeteors();
149:   drawShip();
150:   drawScore();
151:   frameCount++;
152:   requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
153: }
154: 
155: // Input listeners
156: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
157:   if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') leftPressed = true;
158:   if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') rightPressed = true;
159: });
160: window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
161:   if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') leftPressed = false;
162:   if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') rightPressed = false;
163: });
164: 
165: gameLoop();
